title: A laser beam spreads beyond its Rayleigh range
caption: A HeNe beam (633 nm) with waist w₀ = 0.5 mm stays nearly parallel over the Rayleigh range z_R = πw₀²/λ ≈ 1.24 m, where its radius has grown by √2 to 0.71 mm. Farther out the radius grows linearly at the divergence θ = λ/(πw₀) ≈ 0.4 mrad (dashed).
alt: Beam radius in millimetres against distance from the waist, starting at 0.5 mm, reaching 0.71 mm at 1.24 metres and approaching a straight dashed line of slope 0.4 millimetres per metre.
description: Far field: w ≈ θz with θ = 6.33 × 10⁻⁷/(π × 5 × 10⁻⁴) ≈ 0.4 mrad, i.e. 0.4 mm per metre.
axisLabels: distance from the waist z / m
